package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
)

// scenario for upstream_json_decode_same_response_multiple_times: One upstream HTTP response body decoded into multiple targets in the same handler.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: gin; severity: contextual.
func scenario340Positive() error {
	resp, err := http.Get("https://api.example.com/data")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	var users []string
	json.Unmarshal(body, &users)
	var config map[string]any
	json.Unmarshal(body, &config)
	_ = strings.Join(users, ",")
	return nil
}
